## Purpose

This document compares Figure 1 event-study results produced two ways:

- Pipeline (left): Figures from the full analysis pipeline (01--06)
- Share (right): Figures produced using only `sfr_fig1_share.dta`

If the share dataset is built correctly, the left and right figures in each pair should match. The comparison covers two outcomes and two balance definitions across all four baseline spending quartiles (Q1 = poorest, Q4 = richest).

::: {.callout-note}
## What is sfr_fig1_share.dta?

A standalone dataset containing everything needed to replicate Figure 1 without running the upstream pipeline. Unlike the working analysis panels, it retains all states/counties and uses indicator variables (`balanced_strict`, `balanced_lexp`) for filtering, with state validity flags (`vsgd_strict`, `vsgd_alt`).
:::

# Replication Recipe

To reproduce the strict-balance `lexp_ma_strict` figures from the share dataset:

```stata
use sfr_fig1_share, clear
keep if balanced_strict == 1 | never_treated == 1
areg lexp_ma_strict i.lag_* i.lead_* i.year [w=school_age_pop] ///
    if good == 1 & vsgd_strict == 1 & (pre_q_all == 1 | never_treated == 1) ///
       & (reform_year < 2000 | never_treated == 1), ///
    absorb(county_id) vce(cluster county_id)
```

For alt-balance specifications, swap: `balanced_strict` to `balanced_lexp`, `vsgd_strict` to `vsgd_alt`. For raw log PPE, swap `lexp_ma_strict` to `lexp`.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Variables in sfr_fig1_share.dta

| Variable | Description |
|:---------|:------------|
| `county_id` | County identifier |
| `state_fips` | State FIPS code |
| `year` | Calendar year |
| `relative_year` | Event-time relative to reform |
| `good` | 1972 baseline quality flag |
| `balanced_strict` | Balanced on 13-year strict rolling average |
| `balanced_lexp` | Balanced on raw log spending |
| `vsgd_strict` | State validity flag (strict balanced subsample) |
| `vsgd_alt` | State validity flag (alt balanced subsample) |
| `exp` | Per-pupil expenditure |
| `lexp` | Log per-pupil expenditure |
| `lexp_ma` | Moving average of log PPE |
| `lexp_ma_strict` | 13-year strict rolling average of log PPE |
| `pre_q` | 1971 baseline spending quartile |
| `pre_q_all` | 1971 baseline spending quartile (all) |
| `school_age_pop` | School-age population (weight) |
| `never_treated` | Never-treated indicator |
| `reform_year` | Year of court-ordered reform |
| `lead_*` / `lag_*` | Event-study lead/lag indicators |
